title_sq: Ambient komercial per shitje tek Downtown One!
description_sq:
Shesim ambient komercial ne godinen e biznesit Downtown One. Ambienti ndodhet ne katin e 13 te objektit dhe eshte i organizuar open space.
Godine me standarte dhe cilesi te larte ndertimi me hapësira të përshtatura sipas nevojave dhe 8 ashensorë të dedikuar, recepsion i dedikuar biznesi për të mos penguar dinamikën e zyrave.
Sistem qendror ngrohje-ftohje-ventilim.
Siguri dhe mirëmbajtje 24 orë.
Mundesi shume e mire investimi, Ambienti eshte i dhene me qira afatgjate dhe ka norme kthimi te investimit 17 vite.
Per informacione ose vizite ne prone mund te na kontaktoni! smart127008
title_en: Commercial space for sale at Downtown One!
description_en: Commercial premises for sale in the Downtown One business building. The environment is located on the 13th floor of the building and is organized as an open space. Building with standards and high construction quality with spaces adapted to needs and 8 dedicated elevators, dedicated business reception to not hinder the dynamics of the offices. Central heating-cooling-ventilation system. 24 hour security and maintenance. Very good investment opportunity, the premises are leased long-term and have a return on investment rate of 17 years. For information or a visit to the property, you can contact us! smart127008
